decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the firm's established optical navigation offer and is backed by its own R&D and research cooperation, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.

This modular navigation camera line builds directly on decades of star-tracker and optoelectronic know-how and matches the firm's move toward flexible sensors for small satellites, which favours retention.

The situational awareness suite is somewhat further from the core, but it builds on the firm's sensor heritage and EU-funded research networks, which give it enough related knowledge to assimilate market feedback.

The miniaturized LiDAR is close to the firm's docking and navigation sensors and fits its miniaturization strategy, though it was only mentioned on the website rather than given a page of its own, which adds slight uncertainty.
